description: Header file defining structures, constants, and function prototypes for bot navigation and pathfinding in a game AI system, including mesh processing, obstacle management, and route calculation.

classes.name: dtRouteResult
classes.description: Stores route segment result including start/end references, status, and validity.

classes.name: OffMeshConnection
classes.description: Represents a connection between two points in the navigation mesh for off-mesh traversal.

classes.name: OffMeshConnections
classes.description: Manages a collection of off-mesh connections, including adding, deleting, and resetting connections.

classes.name: NavconMeshProcess
classes.description: Processes mesh creation parameters, integrating off-mesh connections into navigation mesh generation.

classes.name: NavData_t
classes.description: Holds navigation mesh data including cache, mesh, query, and processing info.

classes.name: Bot_t
classes.description: Represents a bot agent with navigation data, pathfinding state, and route information.

classes.name: saved_obstacle_t
classes.description: Tracks obstacles sent to the navigation system, including their bounding box and addition status.

methods.name: NavEditShutdown
methods.description: Shuts down or cleans up navigation editing resources.

methods.name: BotSaveOffMeshConnections
methods.description: Saves or updates off-mesh connection data for a given navigation mesh.

methods.name: BotCalcSteerDir
methods.description: Calculates steering direction for a bot based on its current state.

methods.name: FindWaypoints
methods.description: Determines waypoints for a bot to follow along a path.

methods.name: PointInPolyExtents
methods.description: Checks if a point is within the extents of a polygon.

methods.name: PointInPoly
methods.description: Checks if a point lies within a specific polygon.

methods.name: BotFindNearestPoly
methods.description: Finds the nearest polygon to a given coordinate for a bot.

methods.name: FindRoute
methods.description: Calculates a route for a bot from a start point to a target.
